verdict.reason: The group payloads are already semantically compatible and the pair can form a self-contained raw-event-to-Acc24 FC2 kernel with a small atomic header/done adapter and a bounded weight-bank response model. Model-equivalent output still needs quantization/scale, BN2/SN2 and commit identity.

model_source.relevant_semantics: fc2 is bias=False and is followed by bn2 and sn2 in Spiking_Mlp

exact_standalone_boundary.input: One tagged FC2 token consisting of a legal header and raw4 activity beats. Legal geometries are (raw_beat_count, window_depth, output_blocks) = (4,2,1), (8,4,2), (16,8,4), or (32,8,8).
exact_standalone_boundary.weights: External eight-bank signed-INT8 logical weight store with one 128-bit word per active bank and request, an explicit atomic tagged response, and common reset ownership.
exact_standalone_boundary.output: Ordered signed Acc24 result beats: output_block-major, then slice-major, sixteen lanes per beat, followed by one tagged token_done.
included: M216 two-window fixed-bank K8 source selection and output-block replay
M218 FIFO4, O8 tagged request service, signed eight-bank reduction, Acc24 contexts and ordered result drain
finite response timing and backpressure model for cycle measurement
excluded: BN2, SN2, residual add and downstream tensor storage
exact_standalone_boundary.allowed_name: standalone sparse FC2 INT8 accumulation module

header_atomic_fork_join.why_adapter_is_required: Driving header_valid directly to both blocks permits one child to accept while the other is not ready, permanently splitting token ownership.

raw_input.mapping: Directly expose every M216 raw ready/valid payload and raw_last signal at the standalone top.

k8_group_channel.mapping: Bit-for-bit direct M216 producer to M218 consumer with M218 group_ready returned to M216.
invariants: for every active bank b, group_source_channel[b][2:0] == b
tag equals the active token and output_block is less than header_output_blocks
payload remains stable while valid and not ready
k8_group_channel.same_edge_corner: The final group_accept and M216 token_done/M218 frontend_done accept may legally occur on the same edge and must be covered.

required_assertions: M216 descriptor_count is debug/accounting metadata only and is not silently reinterpreted by M218
frontend_done_bridge.top_level_done: Only M218 token_done is exported as final standalone completion; M216 token_done means frontend exhaustion, not completed FC2 arithmetic.

result_and_status.fault_recovery: Hard reset only in the minimum top. A fault is fail-closed and no next token is admitted until common reset.

six_slice_and_address_mapping.request_expansion: Every accepted source group is held in FIFO4 and expanded in order into slices 0,1,2,3,4,5. The group is popped only when slice 5 is accepted.
six_slice_and_address_mapping.request_payload: epoch, slot, generation, token tag, output block, slice, source count, bank mask and one source channel per active bank
six_slice_and_address_mapping.response_payload: echo epoch, slot, generation, token tag and exact bank mask; return signed INT8 weight[8 active-bank positions][16 lanes]
six_slice_and_address_mapping.weight_set_constraint: No module_id or weight_base exists in M216/M218. The minimal standalone instance must bind one immutable FC2 weight image. Runtime reuse across the twelve FC2 layers requires a new idle-only weight_set_id/base field; token tag must not be silently overloaded as a weight selector.

production_adapter: Atomic two-consumer header fork/join with accept-lockstep assertion.
Direct K8 group wire bundle and direct frontend-done bridge.
Final-result/done selection, sticky adapter fault and ORed child status.
Common POR wiring for M216, M218 and the external memory model.
soft_flush tied low and absent from the minimum public interface.

weight_bankset_contract.capacity: Eight equal-depth physical/logical banks; every bank stores one 128-bit word for sixteen adjacent output lanes at each (weight image, source row, output block, slice).
weight_bankset_contract.ports: At most one read per bank per cycle. One K8 request may activate zero or one address in each bank; within-group bank uniqueness is guaranteed by M216.
weight_bankset_contract.request_accept: Atomic across all active banks. mem_req_ready may be high only when every selected bank command and one metadata entry can be accepted on the same edge.
weight_bankset_contract.latency_point: Primary comparison L4/O8/II1, matching M218/M219/M220 evidence. Also sweep L1,L2,L4,L8,L16 and O1,O2,O4,O8 without changing the logical weights.
weight_bankset_contract.response_assembly: A request produces exactly one atomic bankset response after all selected bank words are available. The response must hold valid, identity, mask and weights stable until mem_rsp_accept.
weight_bankset_contract.pending_capacity: At least eight metadata entries so all M218 scoreboard slots can remain live. A fixed-latency pipeline must become elastic or stop requests before a stalled response would overflow it.
weight_bankset_contract.out_of_order: The directed model must support arbitrary legal retirement among matured entries, not only oldest generation. Identity echo is copied from the accepted request entry, never reconstructed from current top-level inputs.
weight_bankset_contract.flush_reset: Common hard reset deletes all pending memory entries together with both child blocks. Soft flush is excluded until M216 gains coordinated flush/reset ownership.

minimum_adapter_and_memory_response_mode.not_required: No global network scheduler, shared cross-operator SRAM arbiter or full accelerator top is required for this standalone experiment.

acc24_commit_and_bias_scale_boundary.m218_arithmetic: For every returned slice lane, sum up to eight signed INT8 weights using the signed9/signed10/signed11 tree, add the result to signed Acc24, and fault on signed overflow.
acc24_commit_and_bias_scale_boundary.fc2_input_activation: A selected event represents binary one, so each active source contributes its signed weight exactly once per destination.
acc24_commit_and_bias_scale_boundary.zero_event_behavior: M218 emits all 6*output_blocks result beats with zero accumulators and had_event=false after the frontend fence.
acc24_commit_and_bias_scale_boundary.linear_bias: The reviewed network source constructs fc2 with bias=False; the correct FC2 linear bias is therefore exactly zero, not an unmodeled bias SRAM.
acc24_commit_and_bias_scale_boundary.raw_acc24_commit: A result beat is committed only on result_valid && result_ready. Ordering is output_block-major then slice-major; result_last marks the sixth slice of the final block. Final token_done follows acceptance of every result beat.
outside_raw_acc24_boundary: per-output weight dequantization or fixed-point scale and rounding/saturation
residual add and downstream tensor write
acc24_commit_and_bias_scale_boundary.complete_model_layer_exit_criterion: Freeze checkpoint-bound INT8 weights and per-output scale, define exact rounding/saturation, then append or explicitly interface the already required BN2/SN2/commit path and miter its outputs against the frozen Python forward.

all six M216 K8 group payload fields plus ready/valid

mandatory_same_boundary_baseline.candidate: M216 SOURCE_CAP=8 + atomic adapter + M218 + eight-bank weight response model + raw Acc24 commit
mandatory_same_boundary_baseline.baseline: M216 SOURCE_CAP=1 + the same atomic adapter + onehot-to-scalar bridge + M219 native-cropped K1 service + the same eight banks, weight image, latency/II/queue policy and raw Acc24 commit
mandatory_same_boundary_baseline.why_m219_alone_is_not_enough: M219 begins at a scalar group. A complete-boundary cycle ratio must include raw4 compaction, frontend stalls, weight responses and result drain on both sides.
same_items: raw header and accepted raw beats

mandatory_same_boundary_baseline.cycle_window: Count from the edge of the standalone header_accept through the edge of the final M218/M219 token_done_accept, inclusive. Never add or multiply separately measured frontend and service ratios.

planning_only_logic_sum.warning: Arithmetic over separate ideal-clock, ZeroWireload, zero-macro DC runs; excludes adapter, memory macros, routing and commit.

structure: Instantiate the K8 candidate and K1 baseline at the same raw4 external boundary.
Replay identical transactions from independent per-DUT source queues so the slower K1 never backpressures the K8 clock measurement.
Initialize two logically identical eight-bank stores from one signed-INT8 reference image and apply identical memory policies.
Capture ordered Acc24 matrices and compare K8 versus K1 only after each independently completes; arithmetic equivalence is not cycle lockstep.
Measure header_accept-to-final-token_done cycles separately and recompute speedup from integers.
functional_miters: K8 Acc24 == K1 Acc24 for every block, slice and lane
both equal an independent software sum over accepted raw event source IDs and signed INT8 weights
same raw accepts, source terms, active bank reads and total weight bytes
K8 sum(popcount(group_bank_valid)) == K1 accepted scalar group count
result beats == 6 * output_blocks and exactly one final done
zero/singleton/tail/dense sources are neither lost nor duplicated

p0_blocker_assessment.classification: These are admission gates, not discovered P0 defects, because M337 admits no current connected performance or complete-layer claim. Any paper claim made before them would be a P0 misclaim.

findings.finding: M216 and M218 are separate token owners. Directly broadcasting header_valid can split acceptance.
findings.resolution: Use the specified combinational fork/join and assert three-way accept equality.

findings.finding: M218 supports epoch soft flush but M216 has no soft-flush state clear.
findings.resolution: Tie soft_flush low for the minimum standalone top and require common reset with memory; add a coordinated frontend flush only in a later revision.

findings.finding: No module/base identity or concrete eight-bank atomic response assembler exists.
findings.resolution: Bind a single immutable weight image for the minimum experiment and implement the exact response model above.

findings.finding: M218 ends at raw Acc24. Scale, BN2, SN2 and downstream commit are absent.
findings.resolution: Keep the first claim at raw Acc24, then close a checkpoint-bound post-op miter before using complete-layer language.

findings.finding: M216 and M218 have never been instantiated together in a finite-memory cycle RTL run.
findings.resolution: Run the specified end-to-end VCS miter; do not add or multiply M216/M218 ratios.

findings.finding: M219 alone does not share the raw4-to-final-done boundary.
findings.resolution: Use M216 SOURCE_CAP=1 + M219 + the same memory and commit boundary as the only primary K1 baseline.

p2_notes: M216's sealed suite left two rare terminal control covers unhit; target both in the connected testbench.
Existing DC areas use ideal clocks, ZeroWireload and zero macros; planning sums are not composed PPA.
The primary L4/O8/II1 policy is evidence-compatible but not yet a foundry SRAM macro selection.

recommended_next_milestone.name: M338 raw4-to-Acc24 standalone FC2 connected VCS miter
recommended_next_milestone.first_cut: Implement only the atomic top, K1 scalar bridge and deterministic L4/O8/II1 eight-bank model; run directed B=1/2/4/8 and conservation/bit-exact checks before frozen H67.
recommended_next_milestone.second_cut: Add stalls, arbitrary response order, hard-reset/fault campaigns and latency/outstanding sweep.
recommended_next_milestone.do_not_add_yet: No global scheduler, no FC1/Conv modes, no soft flush, no weight DMA and no BN2/SN2 datapath until the focused FC2 miter closes.
